question: Gotipua is a traditional dance form in the state of _________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Or**issa.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Gotipua is a traditional dance from Odisha**** India,** and the **forerunner of Odissi**** classical dance.**
 
• It has been **performed in Orissa for centuries by young boys**, who dress up like women** to worship Lord Jagannath ****and Krishna. **
 
• **The dance is being implemented by a group of boys who performs acrobatics** encouraged by the** life of Radha**** and Krishna**. 
 
• **The dance of the Gotipuas goes along with traditional Odissi music**** with the primary clash being the Mardala.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**​ 

 
• In **Uttar Pradesh Kathak** is one of the six leading classical dances of India developed. The word** Katha, from which the name is obtained, means story. **
 
• **J**at-Jatin is the most famous folk dance of** North Bihar,** especially in the **Mithila and Koshi domains**.
 
• Lai Haraoba** **is the earliest form of dance in **Manipur,** and it forms the basis of all such dances. **Lai Haraoba** is a festival still celebrated in the state.
